system_requirements.description: Device shall achieve and maintain sterilization temperature of 121°C ± 2°C
system_requirements.title: Sterilization temperature range is better

system_requirements.description: Total cycle time shall not exceed 60 minutes
system_requirements.title: Sterilization cycle time

system_requirements.description: User interface shall display cycle status and alerts in English
system_requirements.justification: Compliance with MDR user information standards
system_requirements.title: User interface labeling

system_requirements.description: Overall external dimensions shall not exceed 50 cm x 40 cm x 35 cm
system_requirements.title: Device footprint

unit_requirements.description: The rate_controller module shall convert a requested mL/h value into stepper-motor pulses using the calibration table.
unit_requirements.title: UNIT-001

unit_requirements.description: The occlusion_detect module shall raise an occlusion flag when line pressure exceeds the configured threshold for >=2 samples.
unit_requirements.title: UNIT-002

unit_requirements.description: The input_handler module shall debounce touch events with a 40 ms window.
unit_requirements.title: UNIT-003

unit_requirements.description: The event_log module shall persist each event record to non-volatile memory before returning success.
unit_requirements.title: UNIT-004

unit_requirements.description: The hl7_adapter module shall serialise a completed-infusion record into a valid HL7 message.
unit_requirements.title: UNIT-005

user_requirements.description: The device shall allow the clinician to program a basal infusion rate between 0.1 and 25 mL/h.
user_requirements.title: UR-001

user_requirements.description: The device shall alert the user within 5 seconds of detecting an occlusion in the infusion line.
user_requirements.title: UR-002

user_requirements.description: The user interface shall be operable by a clinician wearing nitrile examination gloves.
user_requirements.title: UR-003

user_requirements.description: The device shall retain event log data for at least 30 days without external power.
user_requirements.title: UR-004

user_requirements.description: The device shall support integration with the hospital EMR via the facility's standard interface.
user_requirements.title: UR-005
